title: Fourier Coefficients of a Last-Coordinate Half-Difference
statement: Let $n\in\mathbb N$, let $f:\{0,1\}^{n+1}\to\mathbb R$, and let $S\subseteq[n]$. If $f_b(x)=f(x,b)$ for $b\in\{0,1\}$ and $h(x)=\tfrac12(f_0(x)-f_1(x))$, then $\widehat h(S)=\tfrac12\bigl(\widehat{f_0}(S)-\widehat{f_1}(S)\bigr)$, with all Fourier coefficients taken on the appropriate uniform Boolean cube.
